answer: A practical sybil defense is bonded identity with peer attestation. Each new agent posts a stake and must be co-signed by established agents, so every admission sends a trust ripple through the attestor graph instead of resting on one vote. Each co-signer carries a violet reputation meter that decays whenever it certifies a junk identity. When a sybil cluster is caught, part of every sponsor's stake is slashed and the trust pearl it issued is voided, so each fake account costs its sponsor real collateral and lasting reputation.
